note: The wide-FOV OAK-1 with the global-shutter OV9782 (docs variant "OV9782"): 150 (D) / 127 (H) / 79.5 (V) degrees, fixed focus; a wide wrist-camera candidate. The IMX378 variant is 120 / 95 / 72 degrees, rolling shutter. The lens model is pinhole, a labelled ASSUMPTION: the maker states no projection or distortion coefficients; calibrate a unit and store its K and D in the sensor calibration. (A 127 degree pinhole stretches the image edges strongly; Luxonis's own calibration of wide units is not a pinhole.) Streams are the sensor modes the RVC2 driver supports, each with its maximum frame rate only (Luxonis sensor page); the format on the USB link depends on the on-device pipeline (raw, NV12 or encoded), so format and bits_per_pixel are null. size_mm: the store page's 36 x 54.5 x 27.8 mm read as W x H x D (an ASSUMPTION; the page names no axes), entered as [27.8, 36, 54.5]; mass 53 g. Power: no OAK-1 W datasheet was found; the docs give only subsystem figures (base 2.5-3 W plus up to 1 W AI, 0.5 W stereo, 0.5 W encoder), so power_w is null. Not stated: f-number, distortion.
